title: Average Quality; Quirky.
text: Average Quality; Quirky.. Has some weird quirks in it's behavior. Alarm goes off when resetting the timer; snooze alarm is a short burst of an alarm that lasts a few seconds and shuts itself off; emergency alarm is easy to trigger accidentally. Alarm is not as loud as other competing devices. It is worth the price, I guess, but you get what you pay for. I've begun to rely on other devices for my go to portable alarm needs.
